rumor.dark_berth_1.text: Four ports will berth a hull that doesn't answer: Deadfall, Whisper, Ember, and Wolf 359 b. None of them do it for free - somebody pays for the quiet.
rumor.dark_berth_1.witness.deadfall_scru: A scrubbed number is half the work. The other half is the berth fee somebody else pays - here they log you as expected. The Wolf doesn't bother. Nobody there logs anything.
rumor.dark_berth_2.text: The berth fee isn't paid by the ship. Each dark port has a local who settles the port authority monthly - a scrubber here, a fence on Whisper, the tech on Ember. Follow the payouts and the same buyer shows up.
rumor.dark_berth_3.text: I gut breakers, not ledgers. But every cut-out I install moves through one buyer, and that buyer invoices out of Whisper. Whoever insures the quiet does their books there.
rumor.dark_berth_4.text: The Whisper buyer is the berth keeper in the Hush. Bring him a hull and he'll gut its transponder on the spot - two thousand, cash, and nothing gets filed anywhere.
